name: Perfect Fit
source:
I WON’T LET DEATH DO US PART!

[i]Perfect Fit[/i] is a gothic romanticism of the haunting love between two obsessed lovers. After your crush dies in a car crash, you gather the necessary ritual objects to reanimate her into your life again. When your ritual surprisingly works, you expect her to be disgusted and deny your advances. And she is, BUT, you won't stop until she realizes your love for her!

You’ve summoned your undead crush just to discover she’s obsessed with you! You’re obsessed with her as well, but your ritual isn’t over. Now you have to fulfill the rest of the steps of the ritual and offer more until she has sworn her undying post-mortem love for you.

[From [url=https://oishii.itch.io/perfect-fit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我绝不让死亡将我们分开！

[i]《Perfect Fit》[/i]以哥特浪漫主义的笔触，描绘两个痴迷彼此的恋人之间挥之不去的爱情。心上人死于车祸后，你收集起仪式所需的物品，想让她复生，重新回到你的生活。仪式竟然成功了。你原以为，她会嫌恶你，拒绝你的追求。事实也确实如此。但是，在她明白你的爱之前，你绝不会停下！

你召回了亡灵般的心上人，却发现她也迷恋着你！你同样对她痴迷不已，可仪式还未结束。现在，你必须完成余下的步骤，献上更多，直到她宣誓，即便死后也永远爱你。

[摘自[url=https://oishii.itch.io/perfect-fit]itch.io[/url]]
